verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a first-party Zero Data Retention feature that lets users delete all data associated with completed tasks. It is limited to enterprise plans, and the pack shows it only in a single doc mention. Community worries about sending data to a third party are general concerns, not concrete contradictions. Missing for 10: availability outside enterprise plans, configurable retention periods or granular per-task/per-profile deletion controls, detailed docs on what data is retained and how deletion works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Zero Data Retention is an enterprise feature that provides enhanced data privacy by allowing you to delete all data associated with completed tasks.
